name: adversarial-review
description: Adversarial plan review and code review, driven by a peer agent CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Have the other agent CLI review your work
interface.longDescription: Adversarial plan review and code review. The reviewer is always the agent CLI that is not running the skill: Codex reviews Claude Code, and Claude Code reviews Codex, so the critique does not share the author's blind spots.
defaultPrompt: Review this plan adversarially before I build it.
Run an adversarial code review on my uncommitted changes.
